thread:
Maya R: Quick FYI — I'm planning a short routing/threshold tweak during my oncall window at 10:30–11:00 UTC. Goal: silence noisy `batch_job_timeout` alerts for non-critical batch jobs that are spiking due to retries. Not an incident, doing a smokecheck and will monitor for regressions. Ping here if any objections or if this impacts your work.

Alex P: Which exact alert are you changing and what's the new threshold? Will this affect alerts routed to the Dedicated SRE channel?

Maya R: Alert is `batch_job_timeout` (currently 120s). Plan: bump to 300s for 30m and route to `eng-oncall` (instead of `eng-critical`). Quick commands I'm going to run: 
```bash
# temp rule: increase threshold and reroute
alertctl update batch_job_timeout --threshold 300 --route eng-oncall --window 30m --meta "temp-silence-by-maya"

# rollback (if needed)
alertctl update batch_job_timeout --threshold 120 --route eng-critical --meta "rollback"
```

oncall-bot: Scheduled change queued by Maya R — change_id=chg_20260318_01, target_time=2026-03-18T10:30:00Z. You will be notified on apply and completion.

Joan L: Quick question — could this hide a real regression in the batch pipeline? We rely on that alert for error-rate spikes sometimes.

Maya R: Good call. I'm not touching the `batch_error_rate` alert (kept at normal sensitivity). This is strictly the timeout alert; if error-rate rises we'll still get alerted. I'll also monitor logs and the error-rate dashboard for the 30m window. If anything looks off I'll rollback immediately.

Samir: If you want a quick swap (need to step out), I can cover 10:30–11:00 and monitor alerts. Happy to take over.

Maya R: Appreciate it — thanks Samir. I expect to be present but may need to step into a meeting; will handoff to you if that happens.

Alex P: Can you add the change to the runbook after it's applied (small note under "temporary threshold changes")? Also add the change_id so we can trace it later.

Maya R: Yep — will update runbook and post the change_id and rollback command here after apply. Deploying at :30 (UTC). Posting status here in ~5m after apply. :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: Change chg_20260318_01 applied by Maya R at 2026-03-18T10:30:12Z. Routing now: `eng-oncall`. Previous threshold 120 -> 300.

Alex P: Saw it, checking dashboards now.

Maya R: Monitoring. No anomalies in the first 5 minutes. Will keep watching for full 30m.

Joan L: Thanks for the heads up and the rollback steps.

Samir: I have the page if you drop — else I'll leave notifications on for the next 45m.

Maya R: All good — I stayed on. Reverting at 11:00 if no issues, will post rollback note.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: rollback candidate for chg_20260318_01 at 2026-03-18T11:00:00Z.

Maya R: No regressions observed. Rolling back now and restoring original routing/thresholds.

oncall-bot: Change chg_20260318_01 rolled back by Maya R at 2026-03-18T11:00:05Z. Threshold restored to 120s and route restored to `eng-critical`. Meta: "temp-silence-by-maya" -> completed.

Alex P: Thanks for the controlled run. I'll add a short note to the runbook with the change_id and link to this thread.

Maya R: Thanks everyone for quick responses and the offer to cover — appreciated.
